Twilight Masquerade

Released May 24, 2024 · 226 cards

StandardExpanded

Twilight Masquerade is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Scarlet & Violet series, released in English on May 24, 2024. Its main set has 167 cards, plus 59 secret rares numbered beyond the set (226 in total). It includes 185 Pokémon, 38 Trainer and 3 Energy cards, and is legal in the Standard and Expanded formats.

Illustrators

121 illustrators worked on Twilight Masquerade. Most cards: 5ban Graphics (14), Toyste Beach (6), aky CG Works (5), PLANETA Mochizuki (5), Akira Komayama (4), AYUMI ODASHIMA (4), GIDORA (4), GOSSAN (4).
